character.description: Mochi, a soft pastel-pink half-moon jelly slime blob mascot with no arms/legs

chroma_key.name: cyan
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: subtle breathing squash and stretch while sitting still, one blink

walk.action: bouncing/wobbling locomotion cycle, the blob body squashes down and stretches up as it hops forward, no legs

sleep.action: lying flattened on the ground, eyes closed, gentle breathing rise and fall

eat.action: mouth opening and closing while eating, slight body jiggle

sick.action: drooping and melting slightly, pained squinting expression, pale color

sulk.action: slumped and deflated posture, pouting expression

dragged.action: dangling and swaying while held up, surprised wide eyes

fall.action: falling through the air, body stretched vertically, flailing

land.action: impact squash on landing then recovering back to round shape

pet.action: happy reaction to being petted, eyes closed content smile, gentle wobble

play.action: excited bouncing up and down playfully, joyful expression

file_hover.action: curious sniffing lean toward something nearby, mouth opening

file_consume.action: chewing and swallowing motion, satisfied expression

style: match the attached base/anchor reference image EXACTLY: same pixel density (logical pixel block size), same body proportions, same outline weight, same palette, same shading style, same level of detail. Do not restyle, do not change proportions, do not add or remove detail density. Avoid polished illustration, painterly rendering, anime key art, 3D render, vector app-icon polish, glossy lighting, soft gradients, and anti-aliased high-detail edges.
